#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>

int main() {
    int n, B;
    std::cin >> n >> B;
    std::vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }

    int even = 0, odd = 0;
    std::vector<int> dp;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ++even;
        } else {
            ++odd;
        }
        if (even == odd && i < n - 1) {
            dp.push_back(std::abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
        }
    }

    std::sort(dp.begin(), dp.end());
    int ans = 0;
    for (int x : dp) {
        if (B < x) break;
        ++ans;
        B -= x;
    }
    std::cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
